description: This file contains definitions and function declarations for internal interactions with CPython internals, specifically related to Python interpreter frames, thread state, and opcode cache management. It is intended for internal use within the PyTorch project to facilitate compatibility and integration with specific CPython versions.

methods.name: _PyFunction_CopyWithNewCode
methods.description: Creates a copy of a Python function object with new code object.

methods.name: THP_PyThreadState_BumpFramePointerSlow
methods.description: Adjusts the thread state's frame pointer, potentially allocating a new interpreter frame.

methods.name: THP_PyThreadState_PopFrame
methods.description: Removes the current interpreter frame from the thread state.

methods.name: init_THPCaches
methods.description: Initializes the opcode caches used internally.
